From: Steve Sarver <Steven.Sarver@nrc.gov>
Sent: Thursday, October 1, 2026 7:43 AM
To: Nelson, Andrew C CIV USARMY CENWO (USA) <Andrew.C.Nelson@usace.army.mil>
Subject: [Non-DoD Source] RE: RE: Blast analysis review.

Good morning, Andrew,

                                                         1
 Could you please send me an email, or provide a similar written statement, conﬁrming that you reviewed
the Crane Clean Energy Center blast analysis and documenting the results of that review based on our
phone conversation? You do not need to include speciﬁc details about the equipment I asked about. I
need this documentation to support auditability and the associated project records.

I would prefer that the document not contain sensitive information. If that is not possible, you may send
it to me via SIPRNet at steven.sarver@nrc.sgov.gov.

Thank you for your assistance.

Steven Sarver, Ed.D. | Security Specialist
Mobile: 619-806-5650
